classification.resume: The record contains a newspaper article from the St. Gallen edition of Volksstimme dated March 26, 1936, featuring an interview with the propaganda chief of the Swiss Officers' Society and two additional articles. It documents the public statements and activities of the Swiss Officers' Society during the interwar period. The article was published in a regional newspaper.
